userRequest.text: 다음 쭉쭉 구현해주고 메인 core cli 개발도 계획해줘봐 ㅇㅇ

scope.coreCli: Parse, validate, compile, context navigation, bounded observation and explicit graph adaptation.
scope.registeredHost: A separately configured host plans and runs one explicitly registered external CLI action.
nonGoals: claiming a Lean proof for CLI effects or tokenizer costs

formats.hostOutput: schema-tagged plan, execution and inspection JSON on stdout
formats.registeredProgramInput: only cli-run passes input.value as JSON stdin to the registered child process

currentContract.representations: Canonical resource IDs remain stable; selected local/Git/URL representations are resolved from host bindings and workspace mappings.
currentContract.optionalProfile: adapt --format resource-graph --profile validates an explicitly selected domain profile.
knownGaps: Top-level help mixes command families in one long usage string.
adapt context lacks the source-context traversal and compact byte/digest option parity.
Pure core commands have no bounded explicit stdin pipeline.
No build-and-package-bin smoke test runs the usl executable from dist.

tasks.title: Main entry help and command-family contracts
tasks.currentGap: src/cli.ts concatenates every command family into one top-level usage string; delegated command modules expose independent help strings.
acceptance: Add usl help core|platform|adapter|host without renaming existing commands.
Generate top-level and command-family help from one command contract.
Verify command-family JSON stdout, error stderr, and exits 0/1/2/64 without adding a generic output envelope.
compatibility: Preserve current command names and command-specific JSON schemas.

tasks.title: Adapted context traversal and compact-delivery parity
tasks.currentGap: src/cli-adapter.ts accepts focus, target and compact for context, but not max-hops/max-links/max-visits/via/max-bytes/known-context/stats despite those being supported by src/cli.ts context.
acceptance: Support max-hops, max-resources, max-links, max-visits, repeated via, max-bytes, known-context and stats for adapt --operation context.
Use the same validation and compact fallback/error contract as source context.
Preserve native IDs and explicitly selected resource-graph profiles.
Preserve the existing max-resources policy cap when adding the missing query and delivery options.
compatibility: Do not equate a resource link with access permission.
Do not add automatic tokenizer dependencies.

tasks.title: Bounded pure-core stdin/file pipeline
tasks.currentGap: src/cli.ts reads every source from a file path; there is no bounded UTF-8 --source - contract for pure core pipeline commands.
acceptance: Support --source - only for check, compile and context.
Bound bytes before parsing and give stdin a stable source label in errors/provenance.
Keep observe, file-changing operations and registered-host execution file/config based.
compatibility: Preserve JSON stdout and --out collision protection.
Do not change registered child-process stdin behavior.

tasks.title: Built package-bin compatibility gate
tasks.currentGap: package.json maps the usl bin to dist/src/cli.js, but current CLI tests invoke TypeScript through tsx rather than a built package bin.
acceptance: After npm run build, invoke the package bin symlink for --help and one pure check fixture.
Verify dist import, shebang and exit status.
Retain moved-workspace and cli-list to cli-inspect tests as compatibility gates rather than new host development.
Provide the built-bin check as an explicit post-build command, preserving the current pre-build npm test workflow.
compatibility: Do not add tokenizer dependencies or API cost estimates.
Do not change host registration or external execution authority.
